title: What Are the Turkish Wedding Traditions You Did Not Know?
audience: Couples in their 30s interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, AUD 150k+ budget

refresh_of.note: Person: article to refresh. Recommend 301 to the new URL at publish.

notes: REFRESH: the brief reads the old page in full with mcp__Apify__apify--web-fetch; SEO pulls its ranked keywords and status and checks for other ranking pages. Keep its traditions if sourceable; never reuse wording; re-source claims; drop errors; correct brand terms.

Likely customs (brief finalises): kiz isteme (salted coffee only as 'often told' unless sourced), soz and nisan (rings tied with a ribbon that is cut), ceyiz, kina gecesi, bindalli dress, taki toreni (gold pinned, no amounts), wedding flag, davul and zurna, halay, stepping on the other's foot at the signing ('often told'), Turkish coffee (UNESCO listing where relevant). The red sash briefly and neutrally, or left out if weakly sourced. Use Turkish spelling with diacritics in copy.

Destination angle: Australians marrying in Turkiye. Check Smartraveller's current Turkiye advice live (overall level, higher-level areas) and suggest only areas outside them. Legal steps from official sources only (civil marriage at the municipal marriage office is the legal one; Australian Embassy Ankara or Consulate-General Istanbul documents); 'check with the marriage office and the embassy, including any fees' where unreadable; 'a fee applies' only if an official source says so; 'as at November 2026'.
Sources: UNESCO, Turkiye's Ministry of Culture and Tourism (goturkiye.com, ktb.gov.tr), museums, encyclopaedias, academic sources. Unsourced becomes 'often told' or is left out.
Images: placeholders only; no AI images of people, cultural dress, ceremonies or places; AI only for neutral still lifes (coffee cup, gold coins) labelled illustrative pending approval.

Speed: WebFetch cannot reach outside sites; Apify web-fetch (parallel) and DataForSEO from the start. Fact-check as 2 parallel batches, 15 min HARD, save after every 3 facts, separate scratch folders; no extra sourcing rounds. Google Drive disconnected; Firecrawl out of credits.
Headings must not contain pasted keywords in brackets.
Person's standards: exactly 4 one-sentence Key takeaways; no prices; no vendor names; Advisor claims only from brand-facts.md; business details deferred; Australian English; no em dashes.
